Finding heading 20 px → 24 px 2 Size scale: enlarge explanatory copy 3 Hierarchy: strengthen text contrast 4 Line length: constrain explanatory copy 5 Font: retain the system font This is a retrospective figure redesign, with intentional changes to words, labels and figure order. It is not a pure typography restyle. The automated comparison keeps 82.9% of the original words, below its 98% pure-restyle gate. Its overall verdict remains not improved despite stronger typography checks and no regressed check. These checks measure typography rules, not reading speed or comprehension. The reader-facing figures and scientific values must be assessed separately.
